charts.title: KELT-8 b: orbits around KELT-8
charts.description: The orbits of KELT-8's planets in this map from above, to scale, with KELT-8 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Kokori et al. 2023 (2023ApJS..265....4K), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname KOKORI_ET_AL__2023): P 3.24408156 d

charts.title: KELT-8 b: its transit
charts.description: KELT-8 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (54, 80, 81) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 358516596, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 15-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 15-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
